//: Deployed as a plain static site, not through Vercel's Next.js builder. next.config.ts uses output: 'export', so `npm run build` emits a self-contained folder of HTML/JS/CSS in out/ with no server side at all. Declaring framework/buildCommand/outputDirectory here makes the config self-consistent and overrides whatever the project's dashboard settings say, so a stale Output Directory can't break the build.
